CustomField.description: Derived status of the employment based on dates and current flag.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Start_Date__c), "Unknown", IF( Is_Current_As_Of_Today__c, "Current", IF( Start_Date__c > TODAY(), "Future", "Past" ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically displays whether this employment is Future, Current, Past, or Unknown based on the start date, end date, and calculated current-employment status.
CustomField.label: Employment Status
